in_hebrew.name: ונצסלאב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ונצסלאב הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הסלאבית ונושא משמעות עמוקה. הוא מורכב משני חלקים: 'ונצ' שפירושו 'יותר', ו-'סלאב' שפירושו 'תהילה' או 'כבוד'. לכן, ניתן לפרש את השם ונצסלאב כ'הוא שגדל בכבוד אלוהים' או 'הוא שמקבל תהילה מאלוהים'. השם מעיד על גדלות ועל קשר עם האלוקים.

in_greek.name: Βεντσέσλαβος
in_greek.long_meaning: Βεντσέσλαβος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τη σλαβική γλώσσα και έχει βαθιά σημασία. Είναι σύνθετο από δύο μέρη: 'Βεντ' που σημαίνει 'περισσότερο', και 'σλαβ' που σημαίνει 'δόξα' ή 'τιμή'. Επομένως, το Βεντσέσλαβος μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως 'Ο λαός που δοξάζεται' ή 'Αυτός που λαμβάνει δόξα από τον Θεό'. Το όνομα αντανακλά μεγαλοπρέπεια και σχέση με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Venceslav
in_latin.long_meaning: Venceslav est nomen origine slavicum quod profundam significationem habet. Componitur ex duabus partibus: 'Ven' quod significat 'maior', et 'slav' quod significat 'gloria' vel 'honor'. Quapropter, Venceslav interpretari potest ut 'Maior gloria populi' vel 'Ille qui a Deo gloriam accipit'. Nomen maiestatem et connexionem cum Deo indicat.

in_english.name: Venceslav
in_english.long_meaning: Venceslav is a Christian name of Slavic origin, meaning 'greater glory of the people'. It is derived from two Slavic elements: 'ven' meaning 'more' or 'greater', and 'slav' meaning 'glory' or 'fame'. The name signifies a person of great glory and renown, reflecting a strong connection to God and divine favor. Historically, Venceslav is associated with Saint Wenceslaus, a 10th-century Duke of Bohemia and a martyr of the Christian faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Venceslav has historical significance in the Czech and Slovak regions, as it is the name of notable figures such as Saint Wenceslas (Václav) of Bohemia, who is the patron saint of the Czech Republic and synonymous with good kingship and charitable deeds. His legacy endures through various traditions, most notably the "Good King Wenceslas" carol and the "little red rooster" Christmas feast day.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Venceslav carries spiritual significance as it relates to the virtues of faith, generosity, and renowned leadership. The patron saint, Saint Wenceslas, embodies these traits through his dedication to the faith, his charitable acts, and his commitment as a ruler to the welfare of his people. As a result, the name Venceslav can serve as a reminder and inspiration for individuals to strive for these virtues in their own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Venceslav, meaning "Glory of the Slave," embodies the humility and servitude found in recognizing one's place in God's kingdom. This name reminds us of the value and dignity of all beings in God's eyes, inspiring us to serve others with love and devotion.

historical_references.reference: According to legend, Saint Wenceslas, also known as Wenceslas I, was the Duke of Bohemia in the late 10th century. He is best known for his martyrdom at the hands of his own brother Boleslaus I, who was jealous of Wenceslas' popularity and religious devotion. Wenceslas converted his father's pagan court to Christianity, and after his father's death, he ruled with wisdom and justice. He was particularly noted for his charity to the poor and needy, and his feast day is celebrated on September 28.

Saint Wenceslas is also revered as the patron saint of the Czech Republic. He was canonized in 1179 by Pope Alexander III, and his shrine in St. Vitus Cathedral in Prague is a popular pilgrimage site for Czechs and tourists alike. Wenceslas is depicted in art and literature as a benevolent ruler and a model of Christian virtues, and his legacy continues to inspire faith and patriotism in the Czech people.
historical_references.context: Bohemia, later Czechoslovakia, now Czech Republic

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Venceslav is of Czech origin and translates to 'Slav of Wenceslaus'. In modern contexts, it is often associated with Czech history, particularly the legend of Saint Wenceslaus, the patron saint of Bohemia. This trend is evident on platforms such as Wikipedia, where articles about the saint and his history are popular. Beyond history, the name also appears in fantasy and and sci-fi stories, often used for characters with Slavic or Eastern European backgrounds. One example can be found on Goodreads, where there are many books featuring characters named Venceslav. Lastly, in the video game industry, names like Venceslav can be found on Steam, where players create and customize characters in various games.
